name: DEMO Merit Scholarship for Undergraduate Students
eligibility_text: Eligibility Candidates must be Indian citizens pursuing an undergraduate degree (B.Tech or B.Sc) at a recognised university. Annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000. Candidates must have secured at least 75% marks in Class 12. Age should not exceed 25 years.
institution_requirements: Candidates must be Indian citizens pursuing an undergraduate degree (B.Tech or B.Sc) at a recognised university.
documents_required: Documents Required Aadhaar card Class 12 marksheet Income certificate Bank passbook copy
selection_process: Selection will be based on merit and a shortlist interview.
renewal_requirements: The scholarship is renewable each year subject to securing 70% marks in the previous year.
